verdict.rationale: ReadMe's API Reference explicitly supports making test calls and viewing real responses directly in docs without writing code, and language selection (readme-docs-1, readme-docs-2), which is exactly the runnable-example interactive API reference story. Supporting evidence like OAS-to-interactive-docs transformation (readme-docs-23) and independent community praise for Swagger/API doc support (readme-comm-7) corroborate this is a functional, well-regarded feature. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the 'try it out' call execution itself (beyond docs claims) and no direct AI-native agent interaction with the reference UI itself (agent access is via MCP/llms.txt, a separate surface).
